obligations.requirement: Hosted validation can resolve immutable repository refs used by the Android evidence boundary.
obligations.oracle: The workflow checkout uses complete repository history and the validation job reaches all Android-owned checks without a historical-ref resolution failure.
obligations.acceptance: No required Android-owned command fails because a historical commit object is unavailable.

obligations.acceptance: All listed commands pass and historical G1 source-bound tests are not part of this gate.

obligations.requirement: Android instrumentation output remains facts-only and schema-valid.

obligations.acceptance: Android evidence tests pass with no expected-truth or semantic authority mutation.
